texts.about_this_item: Gav! balanced complete dry food for adult dogs with veal and rice, for everyday feeding. Provides the nutrients a dog needs: proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals. The vitamin and mineral complex helps strengthen the dog's immunity. Economy class, made in Ukraine by Kormotech.
texts.ingredient_information: Composition: cereals, wheat bran, protein-mineral concentrate (meat, by-products, including from veal), palatability enhancer, animal fat, rice, beet fibre, mineral premix, sunflower oil, brewer's yeast, vitamin premix, antioxidant, preservative (potassium sorbate). Additives: vitamin A 5000 IU/kg, vitamin D3 500 IU/kg, vitamin E 50 mg/kg, zinc 130 mg/kg, copper 15 mg/kg, calcium 1%, phosphorus 0.8%. Analytical constituents: protein 16.5%, fat 9%.
texts.feeding_instructions: Follow the recommended amount printed on the pack. Always keep fresh water available.
